meta.homeTitle: Khondlo Tours — Ukuhamba emakhaya, ama-safari nama-shuttle kusuka eHluhluwe
meta.homeDescription: Ukuhamba emakhaya nomhlahlandlela, ama-game drive eHluhluwe-iMfolozi, uhambo lwase-iSimangaliso, uhambo oluya eMozambique nama-shuttle esikhumulweni sezindiza kusuka eHluhluwe, KwaZulu-Natal. Abahlahlandlela bendawo, abashayeli abanamalayisense.
meta.toursTitle: Uhambo olusuka eHluhluwe naseSt Lucia — amanani nokubhuka
meta.toursDescription: Ukuhamba esigodini saseMacabuzela, ama-game drive e-Big 5 eHluhluwe-iMfolozi, i-iSimangaliso Wetland Park, ukuhlangana nezindlovu, uhambo lwesikebhe lwezimvubu eSt Lucia kanye nohambo lwezinsuku ezi-4 oluya eMozambique. Amanani ngamarandi.
meta.shuttlesTitle: Ama-shuttle ezikhumulo zezindiza nemikhumbi — King Shaka, OR Tambo, Richards Bay
meta.shuttlesDescription: Ama-shuttle asuka emnyango aye emnyango phakathi kweHluhluwe, iSt Lucia nezikhumulo zezindiza iKing Shaka, i-OR Tambo neRichards Bay, kanye nokuthuthwa kuya etheminali yemikhumbi yaseRichards Bay. Izimoto zangasese nezamaqembu.
meta.aboutTitle: Mayelana neKhondlo Tours — inkampani yezokuvakasha nezokuthutha yaseHluhluwe
meta.aboutDescription: I-Khondlo Tours (Pty) Ltd yinkampani yendawo yohambo nama-shuttle eHluhluwe, KwaZulu-Natal. Abahlahlandlela bendawo, abashayeli abanamalayisense nezokuvakasha zomphakathi kusukela ngo-2016.
meta.galleryDescription: Ukuhamba esigodini saseMacabuzela, ukuvakashela izikole, ama-game drive nama-shuttle — izithombe namavidiyo angempela ezivakashi zeKhondlo Tours.
meta.contactTitle: Xhumana nathi ubhuke — Khondlo Tours, eHluhluwe
meta.contactDescription: Cela isilinganiso-nani noma ubhuke uhambo noma i-shuttle. Shayela noma uthumele i-WhatsApp ku-082 663 6092, noma uthumele umbuzo ku-inthanethi.

common.priceNote: Amanani angamarandi aseNingizimu Afrika futhi angashintsha ngokwesizini nangezimali zokungena emapaki. Intengo yokugcina siyiqinisekisa uma ubhuka.

home.heroText: Ukuhamba emakhaya, ama-game drive e-Big 5, uhambo lwasemaxhaphozini nama-shuttle asuka emnyango aye emnyango — kuhlelwa futhi kuholwa yithimba lendawo laseHluhluwe.
home.introTitle: Amaqembu amancane, abahlahlandlela bendawo, izindawo zangempela
home.introText: I-Khondlo Tours yaqala eHluhluwe ngo-2016. Siyisa izivakashi emakhaya, ezikoleni nasemapulazini omphakathi wethu, ezindaweni zezilwane esakhulela eduze kwazo — futhi sikuyisa lapho sikubuyise ngokuphepha.
home.introPoint1: Abahlahlandlela bakule ndawo abazi umlando wayo nabantu bayo
home.introPoint2: Abashayeli abanamalayisense namaveni, izimoto nama-SUV anakekelwa kahle
home.introPoint3: Ingxenye yohambo ngalunye lwasesigodini ibuyela emphakathini
home.toursText: Uhambo lwengxenye yosuku, losuku lonke nolwezinsuku eziningi kusuka eHluhluwe naseSt Lucia.
home.shuttleText: Sikulanda esikhumulweni sezindiza, etheminali yemikhumbi noma ehhotela bese sikuletha kwaZulu — ngesikhathi, kunendawo yemithwalo yakho.
home.mozTitle: Izinsuku ezine ePonta do Ouro, eMozambique
home.mozText: Ulwandle, izimakethe zesigodi, ukugibela ama-quad bike nokuhamba ngentambo (zipline) — ukuwela umngcele eKosi Bay sikwenzela khona.
home.communityText: Siqasha futhi siqeqeshe abahlahlandlela nabashayeli bendawo, sithenga kubaqambi bezandla nabalimi bendawo, futhi sihlela ukuvakashela izikole lapho izivakashi zihlangana khona nabafundi nothisha. Ezokuvakasha lapha kufanele zishiye okuthile.
home.ctaText: Thumela izinsuku zakho nobukhulu beqembu, sizokuphendula ngesilinganiso-nani esicacile.

tours.pageText: Uhambo ngalunye lufaka umhlahlandlela wendawo nokuthuthwa kusuka endaweni yakho yokuhlala eHluhluwe noma eSt Lucia. Ukulandwa ezindaweni ezikude kukhokhelwa ngokwehlukile.

macabuzela.name: Ukuhamba ngezinyawo esigodini saseMacabuzela
macabuzela.short: Hamba ezindleleni zaseMacabuzela nomhlahlandlela wendawo, uvakashele imizi yemindeni futhi uzwe izindaba ezidluliswe ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane.
macabuzela.intro: Lolu uhambo esiziqhenya ngalo kakhulu. Uhamba phakathi kwemizi ezindleleni zomhlabathi obomvu ubuka amagquma, uhlangane nemindeni ehlala lapho futhi ufunde ukuthi impilo yansuku zonke, ukudla namasiko kunjani esigodini samaZulu namuhla.
macabuzela.h1: Zwa izindaba ngqo kubantu abadala nasemindenini
macabuzela.h4: Vakashela isikole sendawo noma ipulazi likaphayinaphu uma kuhlelwe kusengaphambili
macabuzela.h5: Imali oyikhokhayo isekela imindeni namaphrojekthi owavakashelayo
macabuzela.know: Gqoka izicathulo ezivaliwe nesigqoko. Ukuhamba kuhamba kancane futhi kulungele abantu abaningi. Buza ngaphambi kokuthatha isithombe somuntu — iningi livuma ngenjabulo.

hluhluwe.name: I-game drive eHluhluwe-iMfolozi
hluhluwe.short: Funa i-Big 5 endaweni yezilwane endala kunazo zonke e-Afrika, eyake yaba yindawo yokuzingela yeNkosi uShaka.
hluhluwe.intro: IHluhluwe-iMfolozi iyona kuphela ipaki kahulumeni KwaZulu-Natal ene-Big 5 yonke, futhi idume ngobhejane abamhlophe nabamnyama. Umhlahlandlela wakho ufunda imikhondo futhi uyazazi izindawo zokuphuza amanzi.
hluhluwe.h1: Funa ibhubesi, ingwe, indlovu, inyathi nobhejane
hluhluwe.h2: Shayela emagqumeni nasezigodini zemifula zendawo yezilwane
hluhluwe.h3: Funda ukuthi ipaki yamsindisa kanjani ubhejane omhlophe
hluhluwe.know: Uhambo losuku lonke luhamba ekuseni kakhulu, lapho izilwane zikhuthele kakhulu. Phatha izibonakude, ingubo efudumele nokuvikela ilanga.
hluhluwe.option1: Usuku lonke, nezimali zokungena nesidlo sasemini
hluhluwe.option2: Ingxenye yosuku, nezimali zokungena nesidlo sasekuseni noma sasemini

isimangaliso.name: I-iSimangaliso Wetland Park
isimangaliso.short: Amabhishi, amachibi nehlathi lasogwini endaweni yeFa Lomhlaba — nokubhukuda ngesifihlakhanda, ukubuka izinyoni noma ukushayela ekushoneni kwelanga.
isimangaliso.intro: I-iSimangaliso ingenye yamapaki amakhulu asemaxhaphozini nasogwini e-Afrika. Khetha usuku lonke noma ingxenye yosuku nokubhukuda, ukushayela kancane ekushoneni kwelanga, noma nje ukubhukuda noma ukubuka izinyoni.
isimangaliso.h2: Bona izimvubu, izingwenya namakhulu ezinhlobo zezinyoni
isimangaliso.h3: Buka ukushona kwelanga phezu komlomo womfula nokudla okulula newayini elibomvu
isimangaliso.h4: Izimali zokungena zifakiwe kulo lonke uhambo lwasepaki
isimangaliso.know: Ukubhukuda kuncike kumagagasi nasesimweni solwandle — sihlela usuku ngokufanele. Phatha okokubhukuda nethawula.
isimangaliso.option1: Usuku lonke, nezimali zokungena, isidlo sasekuseni, sasemini nokubhukuda
isimangaliso.option2: Ingxenye yosuku, nezimali zokungena, isidlo sasekuseni nokubhukuda
isimangaliso.option3: Ukushayela ekushoneni kwelanga, amahora ama-3, nezimali zokungena, ukudla okulula newayini elibomvu

elephant.name: Ukuhlangana nezindlovu
elephant.short: Ukuhlangana okufundisayo lapho uthinta futhi uphe ukudla uRambo noRachel, izindlovu ezimbili ezinakekelwa ngabagcini bazo.
elephant.intro: Hlangana noRambo noRachel eduze. Abagcini babo bachaza ukuthi izindlovu ziphila, zidla futhi zixhumana kanjani, bese usiza ukuzipha ukudla ngaphansi kokuqashwa.
elephant.know: Izingane zamukelekile uma ziphelezelwa ngumuntu omdala. Landela iziyalezo zabagcini ngaso sonke isikhathi.
elephant.option1: Ukuhlangana, izimali zokungena, isidlo sasemini nokuthuthwa

hippo.name: Uhambo lwesikebhe lwezimvubu eSt Lucia
hippo.short: Amahora amabili emlonyeni womfula waseSt Lucia, eduze nemihlambi yezimvubu, izingwenya nezinyoni zasemanzini.
hippo.intro: Umlomo womfula waseSt Lucia unenye yezinombolo ezinkulu zezimvubu eNingizimu Afrika. Isikebhe sihamba kancane ngasogwini ukuze uzibuke futhi uzithathe izithombe ngokuphepha.
hippo.know: Uhambo lwasekuseni nolwantambama lunokukhanya okuhle kakhulu. Izikhathi zesikebhe zincike ohlelweni lomnikazi waso.

mozambique.name: Uhambo lwezinsuku ezi-4 oluya ePonta do Ouro, eMozambique
mozambique.short: Izinsuku zasolwandle, izimakethe zesigodi, ama-quad bike ne-zipline eningizimu yeMozambique, ukuthuthwa nokuwela umngcele kwenziwa yithi.
mozambique.intro: Sikushayela kusuka eHluhluwe siwele umngcele eKosi Bay siye ePonta do Ouro. Uhlala ubusuku obuthathu e-Otia Hotel nesidlo sasekuseni nesakusihlwa, izinsuku uzichitha phakathi kolwandle, idolobhana nezindunduma.
mozambique.d1: Ukusuka ekuseni, cishe amahora ama-5 kuhlanganise nokuwela umngcele eKosi Bay. Ukungena e-Otia Hotel, bese ulwandle noma imakethe yendawo. Isidlo sakusihlwa ehhotela.
mozambique.d2: Uhambo nomhlahlandlela edolobhaneni lasePonta do Ouro nasezimakethe zalo zobuciko. Intambama ukhululekile olwandle, ukubhukuda kungokuzikhethela. Isidlo sasekuseni nesakusihlwa.
mozambique.d3: Ekuseni ugibela ama-quad bike ezindleleni zasogwini nasezindundumeni, ntambama i-zipline. Isikhathi sokukhululeka emakhefi. Isidlo sasekuseni nesakusihlwa.
mozambique.d4: Isidlo sasekuseni, ukuhamba kokugcina olwandle noma ukuthenga izikhumbuzo, bese sibuyela ekhaya. Ukufika eHluhluwe ntambama.
mozambique.inc2: Ubusuku obu-3 e-Otia Hotel, igumbi lokuhlanganyela
mozambique.inc3: Isidlo sasekuseni nesakusihlwa nsuku zonke (isidlo sakusihlwa kuze kufike ku-R200 umuntu ngamunye)
mozambique.exc4: Izimali ze-visa, uma iphasiphothi yakho iyidinga
mozambique.know: Udinga iphasiphothi esasebenza okungenani izinyanga ezi-6. Intengo iyisilinganiso futhi ingashintsha ngokwesizini, izinga lokushintshaniswa kwemali nokutholakala.

shuttles.pageText: Ukuthuthwa kusuka emnyango kuya emnyango phakathi kwakwaZulu, izikhumulo zezindiza ezinkulu netheminali yemikhumbi yaseRichards Bay. Sithumelele imininingwane yendiza noma yomkhumbi wakho, sizohlela ukukulanda ngokufanele.
shuttles.kingShaka: Isikhumulo sezindiza samazwe ngamazwe iKing Shaka, eThekwini
shuttles.kingShakaText: Isikhumulo sezindiza samazwe ngamazwe saseThekwini. Cishe amahora angu-2.5 kuya eHluhluwe noma eSt Lucia.
shuttles.orTambo: Isikhumulo sezindiza samazwe ngamazwe i-OR Tambo, eGoli
shuttles.orTamboText: Uhambo losuku lonke, cishe amahora ama-7, kuneziphumulo endleleni.
shuttles.richardsBayText: Isikhumulo sezindiza esiseduze kakhulu neHluhluwe, cishe ihora eli-1 nemizuzu eyi-15.
shuttles.airstripsText: Sihlangabeza izindiza eziqashiwe futhi sixhumanise ama-lodge, amahhotela nezindawo zezilwane.
shuttles.cruiseText: I-shuttle ekhethekile phakathi kwetheminali yemikhumbi ethekwini laseRichards Bay kanye neHluhluwe, iSt Lucia nezindawo zezilwane — ihlelwe ngokufika nokuhamba komkhumbi wakho. Izimoto zangasese noma amaveni amaqembu.
shuttles.fleetText: Amaveni anezihlalo eziyi-10 kuya kwezingama-22 amaqembu nohambo, izimoto nama-SUV okuthuthwa kwangasese nokwebhizinisi, kanye nezimoto zikanokusho zezivakashi ze-VIP. Zonke zinabashayeli abanamalayisense ne-GPS.
shuttles.how1: Thumela imininingwane yendiza noma yomkhumbi, ikheli lokulandwa nenani labagibeli.
shuttles.how3: Umshayeli wakho ukuhlangabeza nebhodi elinegama leKhondlo Tours.

about.pageText: I-Khondlo Tours (Pty) Ltd isendaweni yaseNgonyamaneni eHluhluwe. Saqala ngo-2016 ukunikeza izivakashi uhambo oluphephile, oluthembekile noluqotho KwaZulu-Natal — nokuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi abayivakashelayo iyazuza.
about.vision: Ukuba yinkampani yohambo nama-shuttle ethembeke kakhulu KwaZulu-Natal.
about.mission: Ukuxhumanisa abantu nobuhle, amasiko nomoya weKwaZulu-Natal ngohambo oluphephile, olunethezekile nolungalibaleki.
about.communityText: Siqasha futhi siqeqeshe abahlahlandlela nabashayeli bendawo, sisekela abaqambi bezandla namaphrojekthi amasiko endawo, sisebenzisana nezinhlelo zokuvakasha zomphakathi futhi sigcina uhambo lwethu lungonakalisi imvelo.
about.whoText: Izivakashi zaseNingizimu Afrika nezaphesheya, amaqembu ohambo nabagibeli bemikhumbi, amabhizinisi, izikole namanyuvesi, abahleli bemicimbi, iminyango kahulumeni nezinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni.
about.expoText: Sibamba iqhaza emibukisweni yezokuvakasha kulo lonke elaseNingizimu Afrika ukuze sihlangane nama-ejenti ohambo, amahhotela nezivakashi ezintsha.

gallery.pageText: Izikhathi zangempela ohambweni lwethu — azikho izithombe ezithengwayo.

contact.pageText: Sitshele ukuthi ungathanda ukwenzani, sizokuphendula ngesilinganiso-nani esicacile. I-WhatsApp yindlela esheshayo yokusithola.
contact.hours: Ukushaya ucingo nemilayezo ye-WhatsApp yindlela esheshayo yokusithola.
contact.name: Igama lakho
contact.messageHint: Indawo yokulandwa, inombolo yendiza, uhambo olufunayo — noma yini esisiza ukwenza isilinganiso-nani.
contact.success: Siyabonga. Umbuzo wakho uthunyelwe futhi sizoxhumana nawe maduze.
contact.error: Umbuzo wakho awuthunyelwanga. Sicela uzame futhi, noma usithinte nge-WhatsApp.
contact.errMessage: Sitshele kancane ngohambo lwakho (okungenani izinhlamvu eziyi-10).
contact.privacy: Imininingwane yakho siyisebenzisela kuphela ukuphendula umbuzo wakho.
